title: made a free browser founder sim where you run a cosmetics startup, code is basically all claude and art is chatgpt, need balance feedback
author: LaonBuilds
selftext:
Not a dev so this whole thing started as an experiment in how far AI can actually take a full game. 

Its a 16 turn demo, you pick how you fund the company (bootstrap, cofounder, angel or VC) and each path hurts in a different way, bootstrap is pure cash survival, VC is board pressure and KPIs. then you deal with R&D budget, OEM vs ODM factories, retail deals and crisis cards where you either come clean or cover it up and it comes back later. claude code wrote pretty much all the code, art is chatgpt with pixel cleanup. honestly the hard part was QA not code, spent way too long on a font bug where C kept rendering as O while the AI kept telling me it was fixed lol. its free, no payment option at all. if any funding path feels broken id really like to know, i suspect VC plus a loan might be too easy.
